text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Oh, a LANE from Taiki... "Next holiday,
want to
have a BBQ party?" Ooh, that
sounds fun!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ack, but that's the same day I'm
supposed to play
Worldwide Windy at
Biko's hero show!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Taiki can be in the hero show too! We'll
be World
BBQ Windy! And then we can
have a BBQ party
after! ♪
